description:
**Requires Patcheddit 2.5.0.** Patcheddit 2.5.0 has its own versions of several of these patches, so they are dropped here and the two bundles patch together again.

### New
- **Fix random subreddit**: Random and r/randnsfw open random subreddits again, sourced from redditrand.com.
- **Explain processing videos**: says "Video still processing. Try again in a minute." instead of an error while Reddit is still processing a video.
- **Inline comment images** now shows tables in comments and text posts inline. With Patcheddit's Inline media, it shows tables only and leaves images and videos to Patcheddit.

### Removed (now in Patcheddit)
Explain Reddit blocks, Post to profile, Fix history import, Fix broken markdown links, Fix comment video links, Fix YouTube videos and YouTube player controls.

### Changes
- The settings screen now sits below Patcheddit's.

### Fixes
- Retrying a failed post no longer uploads its media a second time.

patches.description: Says when a Reddit video is still processing instead of showing an error.

patches.name: Fix share links
patches.description: Opens Reddit share links (reddit.com/r/…/s/…) directly in rif instead of bouncing through the browser, and fixes reddit.com/media image links.

patches.name: Hide blocked mod comments
patches.description: Adds a setting to hide mod comments from blocked users. Off by default.

patches.name: Inline comment images
patches.description: Shows tables in comments and text posts inline. Patcheddit covers other types of inline media.

patches.name: Keep reply box above keyboard
patches.description: Keeps the reply box unobscured above the keyboard.

patches.name: Reddit image hosting
patches.description: Allows uploading media in posts and comments directly to Reddit for hosting. Replaces rif's broken imgur hosting.

patches.name: Repair broken gallery images
patches.description: Shows the images of galleries that fail to load because Reddit marks some of their images as failed.
